description: HTML file defining the front-end interface for visualizing and browsing database contents, including database and table selection, data display, and interactive cell expansion.
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls for data retrieval)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from backend API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses database to show/hide tables, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches list of tables for selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from selected table and triggers table rendering.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays an HTML table with data, managing wide content indication.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling different data types, including objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked, to show full data.
